title: The Koopman--von Neumann--Landau--Ginzburg theory and a Proof of the Kontsevich--Soibelman Conjecture
summary: We show that the Hilbert space of the Koopman--von Neumann formulation of Landau--Ginzburg theory is parametrised by a real Monge--Ampère domain, which carries a natural pre-Frobenius. Restricting to finite-dimensional (dually flat) exponential families, the parameter space becomes a Monge--Ampère domain and a pre-Frobenius manifold.
